messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed both best-score issues:

- [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts:60) now keeps the existing record on equal or worse completions and replaces it only with fewer moves.
- [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx:30) shows `Best: none` when that size has no record.

**Checks:** 140 unit tests passed; all 77 browser journeys passed, including the better/equal/worse score journey. The build and type check passed on Node 26.12.1, npm 11.20.0, Playwright 1.64.1, and Chromium 156.0.8078.4. Both edited files pass Prettier; the full format check still flags 13 unchanged project files.
